verdict.rationale: Dynadot is a domain registrar, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that loads external MCP servers' tools is outside its product category. The evidence describes Dynadot's own MCP server, which AI assistants connect to ("just by talking to an AI assistant"). That is the server role and does not show Dynadot consuming other MCP servers, so it cannot be credited for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
